subtitle: Language, effects, Archipelago, system integration and app data.

display.title: Display
display.afterDarkHint: Also show adults-only worlds in the catalog.

effects.title: Effects
effects.crtHint: Scanlines and the vignette of an old TV.
effects.glowHint: Light halos around buttons, fields and titles.
effects.animationsHint: Screen transitions, typed-in titles, blinking cursor.
effects.reduced: Your system asks for reduced motion: the CRT screen, glow and animations stay off.

ap.title: Archipelago folder
ap.missingBody: Install it from the install screen, or point to the folder of an existing install.
ap.hint: ArchipelaGOAT checks that the chosen folder really holds Archipelago before using it.
ap.notHereBody: Pick the folder Archipelago is installed in: the one that holds ArchipelagoLauncher.

integration.title: System integration
integration.linuxDesktopHint: Applications menu entry, archipelago:// links and .apworld files.
integration.winProtocolHint: For your account only, and reversible: the Archipelago Launcher takes them back if you turn this off.
integration.winAssociationsHint: Archipelago does not associate this patch type with any program.
integration.none: Nothing to integrate on this system

github.title: GitHub token
github.intro: Optional. Without a token, GitHub limits the app to 60 requests an hour (worlds catalog, updates).
github.fieldHint: It needs no permission. Once saved, it is never shown again.
github.encrypted: Your secrets are encrypted by the system keyring before they are saved.
github.noKeyring: The system keyring is not available: secrets cannot be encrypted.
github.plaintextHint: Otherwise ArchipelaGOAT refuses to save them and asks for them again.
github.confirmBody: The GitHub token, the archipelago.gg sign-in and server passwords will be written unencrypted in the app folder.
github.confirmRisk: Any program run with your account will be able to read them.

downloads.label: Downloads
downloads.confirm: Files already downloaded will be deleted. They will be downloaded again when needed.

catalog.label: Catalog cache
catalog.confirm: The worlds catalog will be downloaded again on your next visit to the Worlds screen.

logs.label: Logs
logs.confirm: The app’s logs will be deleted. Keep them if you need to report a problem.

about.title: About
about.tagline: Installs Archipelago and sets up your multiworld games end to end.
about.notAffiliated: ArchipelaGOAT is neither made nor endorsed by the Archipelago team.

archipelago.name: Archipelago
archipelago.body: The multiworld randomizer at the heart of it all, by the ArchipelagoMW team.

wiki.name: Archipelago wiki
wiki.body: Status, maintainers and links of the catalog’s worlds.

ionium.name: ionium index
ionium.body: The community list of APWorlds and their verified hashes.

about.licensesMissing: Not available in a development build
about.licensesMissingBody: The license list is generated when the app is packaged.
